name: LINE group name repair
type: AM Platform / LINE onboarding / Group bindings
requiresDatabases: Existing tenant-local Group Bindings data source

dataIsolation.guard: LINE groupId remains the routing key. Group-summary reads use the shared OA only for the current group, while all binding writes remain tenant-keyed and cross-tenant records are rejected.

changes: Legacy HOZO AM 2.0 onboarding no longer contains a fixed group name
Onboarding uses the current LINE group summary as the binding display name
A same-tenant resend repairs metadata without resetting governance fields
definitionOfDone: Production health reports the repaired build
A same-tenant rebind preserves the LINE groupId and corrects the name
